manifest.name: Analytical static spheres
manifest.author: Asyra Sim contributors
manifest.purpose: Independent local SDK example for static sphere-pair clearance.
manifest.applicability: One static keyframe; sphere radii 0.0001-20 m; shared machine-scale domain limits. No motion, meshes, dynamics or physical-safety certification.
manifest.numericalSemantics: Outward center norm minus outward radius sum; unsigned lower/upper distance bounds and strict penetration. Touching and threshold overlap remain unresolved.
manifest.controls: Noniterative static query: common distanceTolerance, timeTolerance and maxIterations do not change it. additionalError widens bounds in meters, never narrows them.
manifest.reproducibility: Deterministic binary64 interval operations; no random seed. Browser arithmetic conformance remains required.
manifest.resources: One evaluation per pair. Global pair, evidence, wall-time and cancellation/termination limits apply; no commercial runtime.

validation.evidence: Independent analytical static-sphere cases in static-spheres.test.ts. Example status is not an official endorsement or independent numerical audit.
